description: A data pack dimension like Vanilla: vanillite_test:flatland (flat, its own dimension type with height 0 to 128 and coordinate scale 4) is loaded with the pack; /tp and execute in move a player there, back to the overworld at the position scaled by the two dimension types' coordinate scales (1.5 in the flatland is 6.0 in the overworld) and there again; a block set there stays on its layers.

actions.command: execute in vanillite_test:flatland run tp steve 1.5 4.0 1.5
execute in vanillite_test:flatland run setblock 3 4 3 minecraft:stone
execute in vanillite_test:flatland positioned 1.5 4.0 1.5 in minecraft:overworld run tp steve ~ -60 ~
execute in vanillite_test:flatland run tp steve 2.5 4.0 2.5
